title: KPGU Admission Eligibility Criteria & Application Procedure
content:
KPGU Admission Eligibility Requirements & Application Guidelines:
- Undergraduate (UG) Programs (B.Tech, B.Pharm, BBA, B.Sc, BPT, BAMS): Passed 10+2 (HSC) in relevant stream (Science / Commerce / Arts) from GSEB, CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent recognized board with minimum 45%-50% aggregate marks.
- Diploma to Degree (D2D) Lateral Entry: Passed Diploma Engineering / Pharmacy in relevant branch with valid ACPC D2D merit rank.
- Postgraduate (PG) Programs (MBA, M.Pharm, M.Sc, M.Tech): Passed relevant Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
- Applications can be submitted online via www.kpgu.ac.in/apply or at the KPGU Admissions Office, Varnama, Vadodara.
